pinned.name: Time_Warp_Studio
pinned.description: Educational multi-language programming IDE with 24 languages, integrated debugger, turtle graphics, and 28 themes. Built with Python and PySide6 (Qt6).

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS
pinned.description: A bare-metal 64-bit x86-64 hobby OS written entirely in NASM assembly. Features a custom filesystem, TCP/IP stack, preemptive multitasking, Burrows desktop, 140 programs, and 84 syscalls.

pinned.name: GulfOfMexico
pinned.description: Esoteric programming language interpreter — -1-based indexing, three-valued booleans, tiered & tilde equality, temporal lifetimes, compound assignment, emoji identifiers, negative hoisting, and a 5-theme GUI IDE. 170 tests, 26 demos. Based on Lu Wilson's (TodePond) DreamBerd spec.

pinned.name: Time_Warp_II
pinned.description: Time Warp II — a special version of Time Warp Classic, built specifically for the TempleCode language (BASIC + PILOT + Logo fusion). Educational IDE with turtle graphics, syntax highlighting, and retro-computing charm.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS_Classic
pinned.description: A bare-metal 32-bit x86 operating system written entirely in NASM assembly.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS_PicoCalc
pinned.description: Mellivora OS port for the Clockwork PicoCalc handheld device, featuring a full shell, productivity applications, BASIC and Tiny C interpreters, scripting support, and extensive documentation.
